summary: Add comprehensive testing for KeyString length decoding
description:
Unique index key format would be changed to enable PIT reads from secondary. As a result, unique indexes could have both old and new format keys after an upgrade. Reading keys from mixed format index requires distinguishing old and new format keys. 
Index keys are stored as KeyString objects. To read keys correctly from mixed format indexes, a function was written to decode the KeyString and calculate the size of key.

This ticket aims to add comprehensive test for this new KeyString length decoding function.

summary: ReshardingCollectionCloner uses primary read preference when nearest was intended
description:
[sharded_agg_helpers::dispatchShardPipeline() uses the read preference set on the OperationContext already|https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/8422d2de828acf86ffa102b19e75a7552d06d440/src/mongo/db/pipeline/sharded_agg_helpers.cpp#L1031] and therefore ignores [the read preference on the AggregateCommandRequest that's passed into sharded_agg_helpers::targetShardsAndAddMergeCursors() by ReshardingCollectionCloner|https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/8422d2de828acf86ffa102b19e75a7552d06d440/src/mongo/db/s/resharding/resharding_collection_cloner.cpp#L196].

Acceptance criteria: Run reshard_collection_cloner.js and manually verify the profiler entry for the aggregate command can be found on a secondary. If possible, also verify the $readPreference for the aggregate was sent with nearest
